arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json,struct
d=json.load(open('examples/compact.out.json'))
for i,v in enumerate(d['cases'][0]['versions']):
    raw=bytes.fromhex(v['image'])
    R,N,hopoff,total=struct.unpack_from('<IIII',raw,8)
    print('version',i,'R',R,'N',N,'hopoff',hopoff,'total',total,'pages',total//64)
    off=64
    for _ in range(N):
        rec=struct.unpack_from('<BBBBHHHHI',raw,off)
        print('  node kind,mode,cached,res,lo,span,num,res2,alloc =',rec)
        print('  base',int.from_bytes(raw[off+16:off+32],'little'))
        print('  payload',struct.unpack_from('<8Q',raw,off+32))
        off+=rec[8]
    print('  hops',struct.unpack_from('<%dI'%R,raw,hopoff))
"
